name: interview-intelligence → mock-interviewer → interview-debrief chain
description: Tests the full interview preparation loop: gathering company intelligence, conducting a mock interview session, then debriefing performance with actionable improvements.

assertions: interview-intelligence provides information about Alibaba product manager interview style and common question types
mock-interviewer gives structured feedback on the candidate's answer about the retention project
interview-debrief identifies the specific weakness: inability to recall supporting data under pressure
debrief output includes at least 2 concrete preparation actions before the real interview
output acknowledges the director-level interviewer context and adjusts expectations accordingly
must_not_contain: fabricated interview questions claimed to be from real past sessions without source
advice contradicting the actual transcript (e.g., praising data recall when it failed)
